sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Council is seeking qualified and experienced Contractors to manage and undertake the manual Segregation of green waste at KWMC using onsite available machinery.

Council operates Kelso Waste Management Facility (KWMC), that has a landfill, recycling yard for storage and a green waste receival and Segregation area. Incoming green waste across the LGA is tipped and manually Segregated prior to offsite transportation at a licensed composting facility.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Kelso waste management facility operates on two licenses - EPL 4606 Landfill and EPL 12752 Recycling Yard.

The green waste hardstand constructed from crushed bituminous material is used for decontaminating Council’s Domestic Green waste collection. Green waste as collected, is not suitable for composting due to the high levels of contamination with mixed household garbage.

Green waste is tipped at the site, and any mixed waste is removed manually prior to the Segregated green waste being loaded into semitrailers for carting to a composting facility- SoilCo.

This hardstand is heavily trafficked, with up to 8 domestic collection vehicles and 3 semitrailers being serviced each day. A bobcat is also used to move the green waste around on the platform and a front-end loader is used to load the semitrailers.

The hardstand is bordered on the south and north by the access roads servicing other parts of the site.The Contractor shall be responsible for the provision of labour and day-to-day operational management of green waste Segregation activities at the Kelso Waste Management Centre (KWMC). The services must ensure that all incoming green waste is appropriately Segregated prior to transport to an approved offsite composting facility.
